Three programs, each its own download: **Inkt** (word processor, .docx), **Cel** (spreadsheet, .xlsx) and **Doek** (presentations, .pptx). Made by a teenage developer from the Netherlands.

## Which file do I need?

| Your computer | Inkt | Cel | Doek |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Windows 10 / 11** | `Inkt-…-windows.zip` | `Cel-…-windows.zip` | `Doek-…-windows.zip` |
| **Ubuntu, Debian, Linux Mint** | `Inkt-…-linux-x64.deb` | `Cel-…-linux-x64.deb` | `Doek-…-linux-x64.deb` |
| **Fedora, openSUSE** | `Inkt-…-linux-x64.rpm` | `Cel-…-linux-x64.rpm` | `Doek-…-linux-x64.rpm` |
| **Arch, Manjaro, EndeavourOS, other Linux** | `Inkt-…-linux-x64.AppImage` or `.tar.gz` | `Cel-…-linux-x64.AppImage` or `.tar.gz` | `Doek-…-linux-x64.AppImage` or `.tar.gz` |

Have an ARM computer (for example a Raspberry Pi 4/5 or an ARM laptop)? Take the files with `arm64` in the name.
